title: Watcher — cost & ingestion
description: Ingest latency, token/cost by phase, and wiki writes (ADR-0013).

panels.title: Cost (range)

targets.queryText: SELECT SUM(cost_usd) AS value FROM model_calls WHERE strftime('%s', created_at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT SUM(cost_usd) AS value FROM model_calls WHERE strftime('%s', created_at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to

panels.description: Sum of measured cost for every model call in the selected range. NULL cost (unpriceable model) is excluded rather than counted as zero.

targets.queryText: SELECT SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens) AS value FROM model_calls WHERE strftime('%s', created_at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT SUM(input_tokens + output_tokens) AS value FROM model_calls WHERE strftime('%s', created_at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to

targets.queryText: SELECT SUM(messages) AS value FROM obs_ingest_runs WHERE strftime('%s', started_at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT SUM(messages) AS value FROM obs_ingest_runs WHERE strftime('%s', started_at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to

panels.title: Cost per message

targets.queryText: SELECT (SELECT SUM(cost_usd) FROM model_calls WHERE strftime('%s', created_at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to) / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(messages) FROM obs_ingest_runs WHERE strftime('%s', started_at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to), 0) AS value
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (SELECT SUM(cost_usd) FROM model_calls WHERE strftime('%s', created_at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to) / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(messages) FROM obs_ingest_runs WHERE strftime('%s', started_at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to), 0) AS value

panels.description: The number to watch when tuning prompts: total spend divided by messages actually ingested.

targets.queryText: SELECT (SELECT SUM(cost_usd) FROM model_calls WHERE strftime('%s', created_at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to) / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(threads_created + threads_updated) FROM obs_ingest_runs WHERE strftime('%s', started_at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to), 0) AS value
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT (SELECT SUM(cost_usd) FROM model_calls WHERE strftime('%s', created_at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to) / NULLIF((SELECT SUM(threads_created + threads_updated) FROM obs_ingest_runs WHERE strftime('%s', started_at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to), 0) AS value

panels.title: Failed calls

targets.queryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM model_calls WHERE strftime('%s', created_at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND outcome = 'error'
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COUNT(*) AS value FROM model_calls WHERE strftime('%s', created_at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND outcome = 'error'

panels.description: Model calls that raised. These burn a provider request and used to be invisible entirely.

panels.title: Cost by phase

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', created_at) / MAX($__interval_ms / 1000, 1) AS INT) * MAX($__interval_ms / 1000, 1) AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'classification' THEN cost_usd END) AS classification, SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'summarisation' THEN cost_usd END) AS summarisation, SUM(CASE WHEN phase NOT IN ('classification','summarisation') OR phase IS NULL THEN cost_usd END) AS other FROM model_calls WHERE strftime('%s', created_at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', created_at) / MAX($__interval_ms / 1000, 1) AS INT) * MAX($__interval_ms / 1000, 1) AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'classification' THEN cost_usd END) AS classification, SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'summarisation' THEN cost_usd END) AS summarisation, SUM(CASE WHEN phase NOT IN ('classification','summarisation') OR phase IS NULL THEN cost_usd END) AS other FROM model_calls WHERE strftime('%s', created_at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Classification = assigning messages to threads. Summarisation = rewriting a thread's title/summary/items. Series are pivoted in SQL, so no panel transformation is needed.

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', created_at) / MAX($__interval_ms / 1000, 1) AS INT) * MAX($__interval_ms / 1000, 1) AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'classification' THEN input_tokens + output_tokens END) AS classification, SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'summarisation' THEN input_tokens + output_tokens END) AS summarisation FROM model_calls WHERE strftime('%s', created_at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', created_at) / MAX($__interval_ms / 1000, 1) AS INT) * MAX($__interval_ms / 1000, 1) AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'classification' THEN input_tokens + output_tokens END) AS classification, SUM(CASE WHEN phase = 'summarisation' THEN input_tokens + output_tokens END) AS summarisation FROM model_calls WHERE strftime('%s', created_at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Ingest duration per channel

targets.queryText: SELECT strftime('%s', started_at) AS time, COALESCE(channel_title, channel_jid) AS channel, duration_ms AS duration FROM obs_ingest_channel_runs WHERE strftime('%s', started_at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND messages > 0 ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT strftime('%s', started_at) AS time, COALESCE(channel_title, channel_jid) AS channel, duration_ms AS duration FROM obs_ingest_channel_runs WHERE strftime('%s', started_at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND messages > 0 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: One point per channel per run. Only runs that actually had messages.

targets.queryText: SELECT COALESCE(channel_title, channel_jid) AS channel, SUM(cost_usd) AS cost FROM obs_ingest_channel_runs WHERE strftime('%s', started_at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY 1 HAVING cost > 0 ORDER BY cost DESC
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COALESCE(channel_title, channel_jid) AS channel, SUM(cost_usd) AS cost FROM obs_ingest_channel_runs WHERE strftime('%s', started_at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY 1 HAVING cost > 0 ORDER BY cost DESC

panels.title: Model call latency

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', created_at) / MAX($__interval_ms / 1000, 1) AS INT) * MAX($__interval_ms / 1000, 1) AS time, AVG(duration_ms) AS avg, MAX(duration_ms) AS max FROM model_calls WHERE strftime('%s', created_at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', created_at) / MAX($__interval_ms / 1000, 1) AS INT) * MAX($__interval_ms / 1000, 1) AS time, AVG(duration_ms) AS avg, MAX(duration_ms) AS max FROM model_calls WHERE strftime('%s', created_at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND duration_ms IS NOT NULL GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: SQLite has no percentile function, so this is mean and max rather than p50/p95.

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', created_at) / MAX($__interval_ms / 1000, 1) AS INT) * MAX($__interval_ms / 1000, 1) AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors, SUM(CASE WHEN outcome != 'error' OR outcome IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ok FROM model_calls WHERE strftime('%s', created_at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', created_at) / MAX($__interval_ms / 1000, 1) AS INT) * MAX($__interval_ms / 1000, 1) AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS errors, SUM(CASE WHEN outcome != 'error' OR outcome IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ok FROM model_calls WHERE strftime('%s', created_at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Cost by source

targets.queryText: SELECT COALESCE(cost_source, 'unknown') AS source, COUNT(*) AS calls FROM model_calls WHERE strftime('%s', created_at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT COALESCE(cost_source, 'unknown') AS source, COUNT(*) AS calls FROM model_calls WHERE strftime('%s', created_at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY 1

panels.description: reported = the provider returned the cost; computed = priced from tokens by genai-prices; estimated = a configured flat rate (Jev); unknown = no price available.

panels.title: Lapis writes by outcome

targets.queryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', at) / MAX($__interval_ms / 1000, 1) AS INT) * MAX($__interval_ms / 1000, 1) AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'ok' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ok, SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'conflict' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS conflict, SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS error FROM obs_vault_ops WHERE strftime('%s', at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', at) / MAX($__interval_ms / 1000, 1) AS INT) * MAX($__interval_ms / 1000, 1) AS time, SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'ok' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ok, SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'conflict' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS conflict, SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'error' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS error FROM obs_vault_ops WHERE strftime('%s', at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: A conflict means someone (or another agent) changed the page between our read and write.

targets.queryText: SELECT path, COUNT(*) AS writes, SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'conflict' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS conflicts, MAX(content_bytes) AS bytes FROM obs_vault_ops WHERE strftime('%s', at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND operation = 'write' GROUP BY path ORDER BY writes DESC LIMIT 20
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT path, COUNT(*) AS writes, SUM(CASE WHEN outcome = 'conflict' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS conflicts, MAX(content_bytes) AS bytes FROM obs_vault_ops WHERE strftime('%s', at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND operation = 'write' GROUP BY path ORDER BY writes DESC LIMIT 20

panels.title: Recent ingest runs

targets.queryText: SELECT strftime('%s', started_at) AS time, id AS run, duration_ms AS ms, messages, threads_created AS new, threads_updated AS upd, chatter, unassigned, input_tokens + output_tokens AS tokens, cost_usd AS cost, outcome FROM obs_ingest_runs WHERE strftime('%s', started_at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND messages > 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50
targets.rawQueryText: SELECT strftime('%s', started_at) AS time, id AS run, duration_ms AS ms, messages, threads_created AS new, threads_updated AS upd, chatter, unassigned, input_tokens + output_tokens AS tokens, cost_usd AS cost, outcome FROM obs_ingest_runs WHERE strftime('%s', started_at) * 1000 BETWEEN $__from AND $__to AND messages > 0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 50

panels.description: Only runs that did work - the tick fires every 2 minutes and mostly finds nothing.
